item.title: Keeps getting stuck editing files at 100%
item.body:
Type: Bug No real steps here. It's just an issue that happens multiple times a day. Repeat issue that occurs across projects. When making edits, sometimes the agent gets stuck at 100% completion and just cycles. I sometimes have to retry multiple times before it proceeds.
